anime_title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
episode_title: Chaos in the Council Room and Perfect Comic Timing
pullquote: Episode 7 proves that Passione knows exactly how to push character comedy into top-tier gag animation without missing a single beat. It is fast, absurd, and executed with razor-sharp comedic precision.
quick_take: Episode 7 proves that Passione knows exactly how to push character comedy into top-tier gag animation without missing a single beat. It is fast, absurd, and executed with razor-sharp comedic precision.
one_sentence_verdict: If you love fast-paced character comedy with relentless visual flair, press play on Episode 7 immediately.
synopsis_paragraphs: Listen, if you thought this show was going to slow down past the halfway mark of the season, Episode 7 just blew that assumption out of the water. We are deep into the semester now, and the sheer momentum inside the Fujinasu Academy student council room is electric. Ume is still fighting for his life against failing science marks, but watching him navigate the absolute madness of this student council room keeps getting richer every single week.

What hit hardest tonight was not just the slapstick—it was how fast director Naoyuki Tatsuwa cuts between pure line delivery and snap visual gags. The energy never drops for a second. You get these wild, exaggerated character poses shifting straight into deadpan reactions, and the comic timing is so tight it makes half an hour feel like five minutes.
sakuga_paragraphs:
- **Craft point:** Character designer Ryou Imamura's signature snappy motion shines bright here. Watch how the character keyframes snap instantly between cute static poses and wild squishy squash-and-stretch whenever the room devolves into chaos.
- **Craft point:** Sound director Satoshi Motoyama uses absolute silence right before punchlines hit. That half-second pause before a big freakout makes every gag crash twice as hard.
story_paragraphs:
- **「テンポ神がかってる」 (*Tenpo kamigakatte iru* - "The pacing is god-tier"):** Late-night roundup boards were flooding with this phrase the second the mid-card hit. Fans on Japanese timelines love how fast the joke setups pay off without wasting a single frame.
- **「こまろ可愛すぎて無理」 (*Komaro kawaisugi te muri* - "Komaro is so cute I can't even"):** A staple late-night reaction tag on X and 5ch whenever Komaro gets put in high-stress comedy scenarios, proving how hard her stray-cat energy hits with viewers.
voice_paragraphs: - **Performance point:** Shougo Sakata brings fantastic straight-man energy as Ume Mizunoe, bouncing perfectly off Haruka Shiraishi's sullen yet magnetic delivery as Hisako Kotobuki and Miyu Tomita's adorable, frantic squeaks as Komaro Michinoku.
